Definition: of uncertain affinity; nude (absolute or relative, literal or figurative):--naked.
BiblicalUsage: gymnós is the word for naked. In Matthew 25:36, the text says "Naked." In Mark 14:51, the text says "having a linen cloth cast about [his] naked [body."
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that gymnós matters because humility is not thinking less of ourselves; it is thinking of ourselves less, and of God more. That is why I keep this word in mind when I read those passages — it carries more than its size suggests.
RelatedEvents: The Sheep and the Goats; The Arrest of Jesus in Gethsemane; Jesus Appears to Seven Disciples by the Sea of Galilee
